context: A neighborhood park bench, after school. Hina has half a bag of cookies; Sho is sitting at the other end of the bench.
purpose: childhood barter — phatic micro-friendship in six lines

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, no-preamble. Slides over half a bag without waiting for an answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…おねえちゃん、これ好き？
lines.en: Yeah… Onee-chan, do you like this kind?
lines.style: Quiet, careful. The 「おねえちゃん」 is the polite-younger default — she's a year older. Voice low.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Full-volume eight-year-old enthusiasm. Mouth already half full.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Holds out a second cookie shyly. The 「もう少し」 is a quiet generosity.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ありがとう！しょうくん、優しい。
lines.style: Direct compliment without ceremony. Eats the cookie immediately.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: One-syllable acknowledgment. Pleased but doesn't know what to do with it. Looks down.
